nodes.label: ADR 0188: Discogs records matched track by track, and by hand on the songs
nodes.rationale: Matching by album title (ADR 0187) misses records named differently in the library, singles named after another track, and compilations, and what it misses could not be fixed by hand. Track matching shows exactly which tracks match; a certainty score would add a number to second-guess. Links are stored on the songs so they travel with them, instead of in a collection file to sync.

nodes.label: Record tracklist read once (tracks field)
nodes.rationale: Read once per record (a request a record) after the covers, because on-demand reading would break the In GLUE counts and filters. Absent means not read yet; an empty list means Discogs has none (404).

nodes.label: Track-by-track matching rule
nodes.rationale: Title and version must be the track's (an Original Mix is not a Remix); artist is the track's or the record's (a compilation with no track artists: its label); length within 8 s when both are known. Without a tracklist, the ADR 0187 title match stands.

nodes.label: By-hand song links (discogs, discogsNo)
nodes.rationale: A song chosen for a record is that record's whatever the automatic match says; a song taken off with Not on it is never matched to that record again. Stored on the song and synced like any song field.
